description: Datadog monitors for the Admin Moderation Dashboard. All monitors target Prometheus-style metrics exposed by the NestJS backend via OpenMetrics and ingested by the Datadog Agent.

monitors.name: [Moderation] High pending queue backlog
[Moderation] No moderation activity
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
No moderation actions (approve or reject) have been recorded in the last hour. This may indicate a complete outage of the moderation pipeline, or that the moderation team is offline when they should not be.

**Actions:**
1. Check the moderation API health endpoint.
2. Verify the NestJS backend is running and the Supabase connection is healthy.
3. Confirm whether the moderator on-call roster is active.
{{/is_alert}}

monitors.name: [Moderation] Elevated rejection rate
[Moderation] Action latency spike
monitors.message:
{{#is_alert}}
The average moderation action duration has exceeded 3 seconds over the last 10 minutes. Moderation actions are simple database updates and should complete in well under 1 second. A latency spike points to Supabase query slowdown or database connection issues.

**Current value:** {{value}}s
**Threshold:** 3s

**Actions:**
1. Check Supabase / PostgreSQL query performance.
2. Inspect the reports table for missing indexes.
3. Check for connection pool exhaustion or rate limiting.
{{/is_alert}}
